dct_title_s: GRID3 COD - Nord-Kivu - Geospatial Data Layers
dct_description_sm: The GRID3 COD - Nord-Kivu - Geospatial Data Layers 20260928 provides geospatial layers for Nord-Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, including: - Settlement names - Health facilities - Health zones - Health areas This data package supersedes the earlier GRID3 COD – Nord-Kivu Geospatial Data 20260820 version and v9.0 GRID3 COD for health areas, health facilities, health zones, and settlement names layers for Nord-Kivu Province only. It does not supersede versions of these layers for other provinces or geographies. The following changes were made: - Health Facilities: Added 10 new health center-type facilities, relocated 2 existing facilities (CS Kionde and CSR Karete), and updated CS Bukoroghoto’s facility type from PS to CS. - Health Area Boundaries: Updated the boundaries of 4 health areas (Itebero, Isangi, Ngilinga, and Butsili) and added the new Ndindi Health Area. - Settlement Names: Updated the health-area attributes of 2 existing settlements to reflect their inclusion in the newly added Ndindi Health Area. This dataset may contain unintended omissions, as it was developed under a compressed timeline to enable timely information sharing and support teams engaged in emergency response efforts. Dataset citation Center for Integrated Earth System Information (CIESIN), Columbia University, Ministère de la Santé Publique, Hygiène et Prévention, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and GRID3. 2026. GRID3 COD - Nord-Kivu - Geospatial Data Layers 20260928. New York: Columbia University. https://data.humdata.org/dataset/grid3-cod-nord-kivu-geospatial-data-layers. Accessed DAY MONTH YEAR. Contacts and data queries The authors of this dataset appreciate feedback regarding the data, including suggestions, discovery of errors, difficulties in using the data, and format preferences. For dataset-related questions, please send an email to: info@ciesin.columbia.edu
